pages.text: Found in $(place)desert and jungle temples, ancient cities, stronghold corridors$() and $(place)woodland mansions$().

The mask is dry until it tastes blood. Hold it in your off hand while you kill something living.$(br2)It sleeps while the sun is up. At night, put it on and let it take you.$(br2)$(warn)There is no going back, and sunlight is fatal.$()

Becoming a vampire changes your $(bold)Fate$(), not your discipline. A Hamon user who turns keeps their Hamon, but $(warn)using a Hamon move tears a vampire apart$().$(br2)The dead cannot learn Hamon from a book.
